title: WordPress opens responsive block controls; Nemotron Lightning reaches AI Gateway
summary: Two October 14 updates: WordPress highlights public helpers for breakpoint-specific controls, while Vercel offers a free Nemotron endpoint with an important data-retention caveat.
imageAlt: Desktop and mobile block layouts connected to a gateway with a lightning symbol and a privacy shield
imageCaption: Original illustration of responsive editing and model access; not a product screenshot.

sections.heading: Custom blocks get breakpoint-aware controls
paragraphs: WordPress’s October 14 developer roundup highlights Gutenberg 24.1’s public style-state helpers. Custom blocks can use getStyleForState() and setStyleForState() to build controls for individual viewports, rather than leaving that capability to Core blocks.

For theme developers, the practical next step is to check how custom controls preserve styles across breakpoints. The roundup also lists October 20 as the planned WordPress 7.2 Beta 1 date; it is a testing milestone, not a stable release.

sections.heading: A free model endpoint still needs a data review
paragraphs: Vercel announced on October 14 that NVIDIA’s Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is available free through AI Gateway as nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free. The announcement lists tool calling and structured outputs, with access through the AI SDK and supported API formats.

Vercel also warns that the provider may retain prompts for model improvement. That makes synthetic or non-sensitive requests a more cautious starting point for evaluation. Free access is an integration opportunity, not evidence that a workload’s privacy or reliability requirements are automatically satisfied.

zh-TW.title: WordPress 開放響應式區塊控制，Nemotron Lightning 加入 AI Gateway
zh-TW.summary: 兩則 10 月 14 日更新：WordPress 整理可依斷點設定樣式的公開工具；Vercel 則提供免費 Nemotron 端點，但須留意提示內容的保存政策。
zh-TW.imageAlt: 桌面與手機的區塊版面連接至閘道，旁邊有閃電及隱私盾牌符號
zh-TW.imageCaption: 以響應式編輯與模型存取為題的原創插畫，並非產品截圖。

sections.heading: 自訂區塊也能提供斷點控制
paragraphs: WordPress 在 10 月 14 日的開發者月報中，介紹 Gutenberg 24.1 公開的樣式狀態工具。自訂區塊可以透過 getStyleForState() 與 setStyleForState()，建立依不同視窗尺寸設定的控制項，不再只有核心區塊能使用這項能力。
對佈景主題開發者，接下來值得檢查的是自訂控制項如何保留各斷點的樣式。月報也列出 WordPress 7.2 Beta 1 預定於 10 月 20 日推出；那是測試里程碑，並非穩定版本發布。

sections.heading: 免費模型端點仍要檢查資料政策
paragraphs: Vercel 於 10 月 14 日宣布，AI Gateway 可免費呼叫 NVIDIA 的 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，模型識別名稱為 nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free。公告列出工具呼叫、結構化輸出，以及 AI SDK 與支援的 API 格式等整合方式。
Vercel 同時提醒，供應商可能保留提示內容以改善模型。因此，評估時先使用合成或非敏感資料，是較審慎的起點。免費存取提供了整合機會，卻不代表特定工作負載的隱私與可靠性要求已經自動獲得滿足。
